I’m not going to do it anymore.
You’re not going to do it anymore?

I had forgotten all about that.

I wanna come out to California by 2pac and Dr.Dre. I think that’d be really good.

ex: And that’s the big tune that Ricky will be coming out to when he has his celebrity boxing match.
We’re all looking forward to that, Rick.

q: Ricky said a Jim Reeves song used to make him cry when he was little. What happens in it, according to Ricky?

He gets home and Mary-Anne has married his brother
His horse wins a big race and then collapses

ex: I tell ya, there was a song a bit like that by Jim Reeves, erm, probably out about the same time, a little bit before, right? It was just called, um “Just A 100 Miles From Mary-Anne”, right, and it was him and his horse going through the…
Right, right. He stopped at a Little Chef?

N-no…yeah, passes another donkey – no, but, um, it’s really sad and used to make me cry when I was little ‘cos he’s got there, right, and he would leave Old Ben, the horse, and then, he dies in the snow and so he dies in the snow…
He’s gone again, you’ve gone again. No, I get the same way, teary-eyed, with ‘Two Little Boys’.

q: According to Ricky, Karl's stories always start off nice and funny. How do they leave him feeling by the end?

I don’t know whether to hug him, or shoot him.
Put him out of his misery. Can we take Karl to the – phone in if you think I should take Karl to the vet’s, and have him put down. ‘Cause it’s just too stressful!

q: Taking ideas for Karl's next film role, Ricky said it needn't even be a human. What did he say Karl would be very good as?

ex: And don't- don't imagine that is has to be a male character. I imagine that you could play, for instance, Sharon Stone's role in Basic Instinct.
I don't imagine it has to be a human. I mean, uh- uh- uh, I mean an animal or an object.
He'd be very good as a rock.

q: Ricky recalled a 'greatest lyrics of all time' poll. Two of the top five songs were by which artist?

ex: But that's always the thing isn't it? It's sorta like any poll- I remember I think it was last year, the greatest lyrics of all time. 1 was "Imagine" by John Lennon, which is- you know, if anything's going to get that-
And there was maybe like Dylan or another Beatles one or somat. And- two in the top five were Robbie Williams songs.
One of the worst lyricists ever.

q: Little Ricky's beloved red pedal go-kart vanished from behind the shed. What had his dad swapped it for?
f: Dad swapped it with a bloke called Jimmy Dublin. Ricky: "It was caked in concrete, I could hardly lift it - just nicked off a building site, obviously."
ex: Can I tell you about one of the best presents I ever had? Without a doubt, all I ever wanted was a go-kart, this is true, I was about, like, 5, 6, 7, and I eventually, for Christmas, ermm, I wasn't spoilt in the sense that I got pocket…

Yeah, I went... "He what?", and I was going to be brave, I went "He what?", she went "He swapped it for a wheelbarrow", and I could see she didn't approve of this, and she was thinking "I'm going to tell him, and then I'm going to, you…
I bet he was a respectable member of the community.
He was fine, no, this is libel...no I think he was an Irish gentleman.

ex: It's- yeah, yeah. He's got- he's- he's got- f- he's eatin' lovely McVities Original Digestives, are we allowed to- can I- if McVities are listening, I love these biscuits.
Um, and uhh, and he's got the best--
If the Spearmint Rhino Street Clubs are listening, I'm a huge fan.

He serenaded her from his balcony

Just got to know him and then she kept saying "send a picture" and he goes "no, I'm not sending a picture, come round".

q: To mock Karl's message-deleting, Ricky pretended he had forgotten to pass on what news?

Karl's Auntie Nora had won the pools

ex: (Interrupting) Oh! Karl, that doctor called last week. That kidney's ready for that little girl that you were doing that sponsored walk for. I forgot to tell you.
I hope it's still all right. They keep it on ice, don't they? I think they do.
Selfish Karl. So selfish. And you've lost us a Sony.

q: Ricky's headmaster squeezed out a tube of toothpaste and told a kid to put it back. What did Ricky reckon the nine-year-olds actually learnt?
a: Don't squeeze all the toothpaste out, save some
x: Always brush your teeth twice a day
Toothpaste makes a mess of a board
f: The intended moral was "it's easier to do something than undo it." Steve's simpler method: "Just stop misbehaving or I'll smack you."
ex: I worked when I was about nine. The headmaster. W. Headmaster used to do a little fable. I've talked about him a stand up, he's doing a fable. There's one I remember where he got a tube of toothpaste and he got someone up, said, you come…

Yeah, yeah, Just stop Misbehaving or I'll smack you. That worked. Carl, have you had to have any dealings with kids? How do you get on with kids? Do you relate to them or are they just as angry and perplexed by your views as we are?

q: When Steve guessed that clinking glasses was to do with poison, what did Ricky ask?
a: Would it make a different noise?
x: Would the drink start to fizz?

ex: Why do they tink? The verb “to tink.”
I do know that, Karl. Is it about poison?
Why, would it make a different noise?

q: Steve imagined Karl preserved for a million years and ruling the world. How did Ricky picture King Karl?
a: As a head in a fish tank
x: As a brain in a bread bin
As a robot with a round head
As a statue made of baguettes

ex: In a million years’ time, I love the idea of Karl…
…he’s been preserved, brought back to life but he’s now the ruler of the world…
Just a head in a fish tank.
(in deep bass) And he speaks like this. “I am Pilkington.”
The reason, the reason you became king of the universe of course is because of your fascinating French bread anecdote.

q: Ricky took Steve bowling. What did Steve's size 14 bowling shoes remind Ricky of?

ex: You went to a funny school... I went bowling with him once right, and I'd never been bowling before and he'd been once before, and he went "Let's go to this bow"--- Went to this bowling alley, right, and erm, you have to wear these special…
Yeah but they don't look freaky-clown-like when I'm wearing them, 'cause the rest of me's in proportion to it!
He looked like a little wall bracket.

I'll just have a Wispa and go home

"Actually, Karl, I want you to take over the factory. It was a test."
I just wanted to look 'round the chocolate factory. I'm happy to go back and live poor.
I'll work it, but I'm not working Mondays

q: Steve said he refuses to eat out with Ricky. What did Ricky moan is 'always' served at awards dos?
a: Salmon, hardly cooked, followed by lamb

ex: I refuse to eat out with Ricky cause I can't, it just sucks the life out of me. It actually makes me depressed. I can't enjoy the experience. If you go to an awards do, they bring out a lovely grub, lovely food, you know three courses.
Which is hardly cooked, followed by lamb.
Lovely bit of lamb! Who doesn't think lamb is the best of all the meats?!

ex: No it's not cryptic because a cryptic clue actually makes sense -- every part of it -- you might as well call this "What Band Am I Thinking Of?"

It's Karl's old Simply Red single

Is that better or better than [inaudible]?
Well it's a goal one but I just got the shop to put, write, platinum on it.

q: Karl's Diary claimed paintings of a crying boy caused 1980s house fires. Ricky debunked it by comparing it to blaming fires on what?

ex: And what happened is they found out that a load of houses were being set on fire or burst into flames, whatever. And the weird thing was...
Every house that burned down had that photograph of...

Yeah, because every house had that picture in the f***ing seventies and eighties. Idiot. It's like we're linking it to sinks. Every house that's ever burned down had a sink. You're talking s*** again. Carry on.

q: Playing pool at Ricky's house, why did Ricky make a fuss about Karl's hands?
a: They were sticky from cake Jane had given him
x: He'd been eating salt and vinegar crisps
He kept chalking his fingers instead of the cue
He'd been stroking next door's cat

ex: Got on the tube to Camden, read in a free newspaper that hedgehogs could be gone by 2025. I think I've seen more dead hedgehogs than alive ones anyway, so I don't think I'll miss them. Went round to Ricky's house and had a game of pool. It…

It was sugar and it wasn't that either. After he'd finished it, they weren't just sticky, he was licking his fingers, sucking his fingers off, and then was going to pick up pool cues and touch things. And I was thinking, go and wash your…
This turned into an argument when I said I didn't want to wash my hands.

He goes for a piss all the time without washing his hands and then squeezes my head. I know I'd prefer to have lemon cake crumbs on my head than knob juice. Was gonna do a crossword, but I'm tired and have learnt enough today.

q: Asked to back Steve up against the 'albatross' insult, how did Ricky describe Steve's dancing instead?
a: An upright lizard being given electroshock treatment

A coat stand caught in an earthquake
A deckchair being put up by a drunk

ex: I mean, you've seen me dancing. How would you describe me?
I think that you look like a. Isn't an albatross. You look like an upright lizard. Right. Being given electroshock treatment. And I think that's a lot fairer, isn't it, than the albatross nonsense.
Well, I'm just trying to picture that because again, was that a compliment? You were on my side, right?
You were defending with it a cross between a giant lizard and a stick insect.
Again, because they don't sound straight away, they don't sound like compliments, but I'm assuming you're on my side here.
Stick insect with funny glasses, is that again.

Yeah, it’s particularly unique to Liverpool, isn’t it?
It’s sort of happy and teeth and ears. D’y’know what I mean?
It’s happy and teeth and ears.

x: Doing the Krypton Factor assault course

ex: R.E.M - Electrolite on XFM 104.9. Ricky Gervais, Stephen Merchant and Karl Pilkington. Um, I walk, uh, down Oxford Street every day to go to the office and it is like running the gauntlet in Gladiator.
It's not only is it just like, you know, you have to dodge people and their dawdling or rushing or, you know, keeping into the road to get pass some people but avoiding taxis.
But it's like hands everywhere like leaflets. I don't know there must be a million leaflets given out. It's all...

That's what you get when you put a duck in a microwave.

That it was bigger than the Lottery

ex: To me, philosophy might be the greatest subject of all academic subjects. The mother of science, asking the big questions: Why are we here? How do we live? But it's been sort of mugged and kidnapped by those people who put rubbish under…
Doris Stokes being, for those that don't know?
A medium who said she was talking to the dead as crystals. Feng shui. Oh, God.

s: The Ricky Gervais Guide to Philosophy · 2009
ex: Got the problem hole in your head.
"Got the problem hole in your head" Shut up, Ricky! Let him say what he needs to say!
He said it! He's got a problem hole in his head. It's called his mouth.
Right, that is your problem hole.

a: Ricky prodding him and filming him on the toilet

Ricky locking him in the tour bus

ex: I would love to be able to say most of the things that Ricky comes up with are for an audience, but they're not. They are just for him. So, for instance, when in Brighton, he started dancing around the room, singing the song, he's fluffy…

ex: Robin claims he's a vegetarian, but he started eating fish on tour, right, because it's lovely fish and it's all free, right? So he's going against his principles a little bit. But all I'm gonna ask you to do as he's getting a little free…
I don't think so. I mean, is he a vegetarian or not exactly.

Some people. No, no. Some people who are religious say thank you, Lord. I think so. All I'm asking, Robin, and this isn't much to ask, is when you pick up a sandwich with a fish, you've killed in it, just say, sorry, fishy, I love you and…

Kiss it and say thank you

Why am I doing this? I'm 38 years old.

Just go. Descend it. Quickly. The battery's running out. Just end it. End the thing and then squeeze the can and put it on your head. Right, go. Go on. All in one. Suck it down. Suck it down. Go on. All in one. All in one. Yeah. Excellent…

q: Karl said an Elvis song always makes the hairs go up on his back, and he didn't know why. What was Ricky's explanation?

Because his back hair is the clever bit
Because Suzanne turns the heating off

ex: No it does, yeah. There's an Elvis song that me hairs always go up on me back every time I hear it. I don't know why. Every time I hear-
Well I know why, 'cause there's none on your head.

A day out with Karl and Suzanne

ex: So what I thought was, we’ve got, we’ve got to frame it Karl, we got to put the copy of Heat in or summut, you’ll have to…t,t,the winning show, the show that they win on, erm, you’ll have to do a copy of that, you know what I mean, they…

We can’t do that, we don’t allow people in, but what I thought was, what about the winner gets to come in a squeeze your head? So they get in, just, just for two minutes, we present them with it, yeah?
What d’you mean no? It’s for charity
I’m not having strangers coming in squeezing my head.

q: Ricky brought a genuine packet of 'cock soup' into the XFM studio. What brand was it?

ex: I just found it out there. Sorry, yeah, it is Rooster's Pride 'cock soup' noodle soup mix chicken flavour, but I mean do they not know that is obviously just going to be used on The Graham Norton Show and Chris Tarrant when he's doing his…
Well no, it's fine because you can say cock as long as it means the male-we've done this.
Yeah, look. It's a picture of a chicken.

They were just cracking up this this was..
Whenever one my mate's brothers came round, he came up and said 'where's your nursery rhyme book. and he'd read it to 'em.
And it was just the funniest thing in the world.

He's a producer, not a professor

ex: When did the light bulb come in cause I can't remember at the moment?
So um… yeah so there's no light bulb.
Well you wouldn't know anyway, you're a- you're a doctor you're not a historian. Go on.

q: As Karl finally finished his very long cryptic song story, how did Ricky react?

He played the Countdown clock music

ex: And it’s going, “Oh, I’m all hot. I’m burning.” And all his skin’s, sort of, really red raw because of all the flames in hell an’ stuff. So he goes, “Ohh.” He said, uh, “I’ll tell you what; I’ll take you to the doctor’s.” And the little…
That was, uh, Ricky Gervais on XFM. It’s three o’clock now. We’re going over to Natasha. Thanks very much. See you next week. Bye!
Man alive. That was, that was quite a long story.

Oh, so you can't take anything that's useful. It's just, you know, it's. It's, you know, it's. And your luxury item, you can't. I took a vat of Novocaine. I thought, if I get toothache, I'm sipping on that till I die. If I'm stuck here…

That was his name! That was his name: Willynilly. That was his stage name. And you come on and show them off-

Well... I suppose that time it didn't. But since...
Oh subsequent information has come up!
Oh okay, sorry! This is like Columbo, innit?

x: A goat for an African family

ex: I was honestly? I was thinking of giving you another signed Extras DVD.
Some, anything. It's the thought that counts, so that would be great.
'Cause I've got some knocking round. I can give you one of those. I know you've already got one of those, but I don't mind, they don't cost me much.

ex: Just think, Alan Bennett has to sit down and really sweat over his stories.
You are a living Alan Bennett character.

q: Karl rates Rome the greatest city in the world, partly because the Colosseum is just there in a busy road. What was Ricky's response?
